job.title: Content Marketeer @ Atlas Copco Group (Antwerpen, VLG, BE)
job.description:
Job Description

**Your role**
-------------

As Content Marketeer, you will turn our products, services and customer value propositions into engaging, customer-focused content that strengthens our digital presence, supports our sales teams and contributes to business growth.

You will work closely with our Product Marketing Managers to translate technical and commercial input into content that is clear, relevant and easy to understand. Whether you are creating a product brochure, developing a blog article, improving a webpage or preparing content for a campaign, you will always start from the same question: what does our customer need to know, and how can we make that message as relevant and engaging as possible?

You will create and manage product marketing content across different digital and commercial channels, including webpages, brochures, product visuals, blog articles, white papers, social media content and sales enablement platforms such as MyToolbox and Showpad. You will make sure that our content supports the different stages of the customer journey and helps our Customer Centers and sales teams bring our service solutions to the market.

Digital will be an important part of your role. You will maintain and improve product-related web content, support translation workflows and collaborate on digital customer experience initiatives. You will also create content for marketing campaigns and automation flows and use performance insights to understand what works, what can be improved and where we can create more impact.

At the same time, we want to make the way we work with content smarter and more scalable. You will help us establish clear content marketing processes so that content can be created, translated, published, updated and reused efficiently across our global organization.

You will become an important link between Product Marketing, our Customer Centers, Communications and Digital Marketing, and external partners when needed. It is a role for someone who enjoys combining creativity with structure and who wants to turn complex ideas into content that makes sense to customers. You will report directly to the VP Marketing of PTS.

**Your day-to-day**
-------------------

* Own product marketing content (brochures, product visuals, ...etc.)
* Manage digital and web content
* Create campaign content using marketing automation and follow up on metrics
* Process improvement

**Your skills and experience**
------------------------------

What matters most to us is your curiosity, creativity and ability to look at content through the eyes of our customers. You enjoy making complex or technical information simple and engaging, and you are equally comfortable creating content yourself and coordinating with different stakeholders.

* Experience in content marketing, product marketing, digital marketing or sales enablement , ideally in a B2B environment.
* Strong writing and editing skills , with the ability to translate technical information into clear, customer-focused messages.
* A good understanding of digital channels, customer journeys and content marketing , and an interest in using content performance to continuously improve.
* A structured and collaborative way of working, with the ability to manage different stakeholders, channels and content priorities.
Experience with, or the curiosity to learn, digital content and marketing tools such as AEM, MyToolbox, Showpad, SharePoint, Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud and marketing automation platforms .  

You do not need to tick every box from day one. If content marketing excites you, you understand how good content can make a difference for customers, and you are eager to learn, we would be happy to hear from you.

**Your compensation and benefits**
----------------------------------

At Atlas Copco Group, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation is determined based on the position and its responsibilities, without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our compensation offering is designed to be locally relevant, competitive, and aligned with the expectations of current and future talent.

Beyond compensation, we believe that a rewarding career is about having opportunities to learn, grow, contribute, and develop in an environment built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work.

**Your job location**
---------------------

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely (40%) and being on-site (60%) at our Atlas Copco Airpower offices in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).

**Why it is great to work with us**
-----------------------------------

Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you.

**Application process**
-----------------------

Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. job.title: Marketing Coordinator @ Tomorrowland (Antwerpen, VLG, BE)
job.description:
Description

At Tomorrowland, we believe strong ideas can connect people and set positive change in motion. With **Love Tomorrow** and **Lab of Tomorrow,** we bring people, organisations and ideas together around sustainability, innovation and impact. Together they form Better Tomorrow, Tomorrowland's innovation and sustainability cluster. To help those stories, initiatives and partnerships grow further, we are looking for an experienced Marketing Coordinator. Someone who enjoys translating strategic ambitions into concrete marketing actions, keeps an overview across different brands and channels, and above all gets energy from achieving things together.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

As **Marketing Coordinator,** you help shape and coordinate the marketing activities within Better Tomorrow. From 2027, the team will work from four connected pillars: Build, Accelerate, Inspire and Implement & Measure.

You translate the objectives of these pillars into clear marketing plans and strong campaigns, with respect for each brand's own identity. You work closely with a freelance Content Marketer, a designer, video freelancers, agencies and a marketing intern.

Together with the Growth & Finance Lead, you set priorities and monitor results and budgets. Lines are short, and you are given the space to take responsibility and turn ideas into action.

Concretely, this means you:

* translate the objectives of the different pillars into marketing plans, campaign calendars and content planning;
* coordinate and execute online, offline and out-of-home campaigns, from briefing to evaluation;
* manage the newsletters and websites of the different brands, together with external partners and agencies;
* develop co-marketing campaigns with partners that create value for both the partner and Better Tomorrow;
* act as the marketing point of contact for partners around the Love Tomorrow Summit, in close collaboration with the account coordinator;
* support PR and media initiatives and help safeguard event communication and materials;
* manage the marketing budget and steer freelancers, agencies and creative partners;
* actively explore how AI and smart tools can make our marketing processes more efficient, creative and powerful.

Within the four pillars, you work on a wide range of challenges: from attracting new members and residents for Lab of Tomorrow and marketing The Impact Circle, to further developing the Love Tomorrow Summit and Community Days. For Love Tomorrow Solutions, you help translate results and insights into relevant stories, cases and content.

**Must Haves**
--------------

We are looking for someone who combines marketing expertise with curiosity, creativity and a strong sense of collaboration.

* You have at least 5 years of relevant marketing experience and are used to rolling up your sleeves.
* Campaigns, content, newsletters and websites hold few secrets for you.
* You have experience with co-marketing and partnerships and understand how to make collaborations relevant for both parties.
* You have experience with marketing budgets and with briefing and managing freelancers and agencies.
* You work comfortably with CMS and newsletter platforms.
* You are highly organised and keep multiple brands, partners, projects and deadlines moving at the same time.
* You have a keen eye for brand identity, quality and consistent execution.
* You are a strong storyteller who can translate themes such as sustainability, innovation and impact in a credible and appealing way.
* You are curious about AI and see opportunities to use technology smartly in marketing.
* You feel an affinity with sustainability, innovation, entertainment and events.

Experience in event or B2B marketing is a strong asset. Have you already experimented with AI solutions or AI agents in marketing? Then that is a nice bonus.

**What we offer**
-----------------

You join an entrepreneurial and creative environment where ideas can quickly become reality. You work across different brands, projects and partnerships, and gain access to a broad international network in entertainment, technology, innovation and sustainability.

Above all, you get the chance to help build, together with a driven team, initiatives that connect and inspire people and make positive change possible.

  
Languages Dutch; Flemish English

job.title: Content Lead @ o2o Bicycle Leasing (Ghent, Flemish Region, Belgium)
job.description:
Fietsleasing voor werknemers? Via o2o Bicycle Leasing, natuurlijk. Jep, dat kunnen we mooi zelf zeggen. Maar hoe zorgen we ervoor dat HR-verantwoordelijken dat ook weten? Da’s jouw focuspunt als Content Lead. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze doelgroep ons kent en met ons in gesprek wil. Of ze nu zoeken bij hun sociaal secretariaat, in Google of in een AI-assistent (of in hun dromen).
  
  
Wie is o2o Bicycle Leasing?
  
  
Wij zijn een levendige scale-up die
**fietsleasing eenvoudig en toegankelijk maakt**
voor bedrijven én werknemers. Onze missie? Meer mensen op de fiets - omdat dat gewoon beter is, voor henzelf en ook voor de planeet. En stiekem ook een beetje om die files te slim af te zijn.
  
  
We doen dat met een team vol geëngageerde collega’s, in een cultuur die inzet op vertrouwen, autonomie en een stevige portie goesting. En soms ook wat knaldrang. (Nog meer info over ons? Vind je hier.)
  
  
Wat je doet als Content Lead
  
  
Deze job is
**half strategisch**
,
**half uitvoerend**
. De ene helft van je tijd zet je mee de koers uit: je denkt mee over de content- en socialmediastrategie, scherpt keuzes aan en coacht het contentteam. De andere helft ga je er zelf mee aan de slag. We zoeken geen copywriter, die skill zit bij onze Content Marketeer, maar iemand die ervoor zorgt dat
**elk contentstuk een doel heeft**
. De leidinggevende rol en eindverantwoordelijkheid over marketing blijft bij onze Teamlead Marketing.
  
  

* Je neemt de strategische lead voor content. Je ontwikkelt de contentstrategie samen met de Teamlead Marketing, werkt met onze Content Marketeer een contentplan uit en bepaalt de doelstellingen van contentmarketing.
* Je bouwt AI-workflows en contentautomatisaties, samen met onze Digital Marketeer. AI doet het voorwerk voor research, drafts, vertalingen en metingen, en neemt ook repetitieve contenttaken van ons over. Jij weet perfect wanneer AI een meerwaarde levert, en wanneer niet (meer).
* Je bepaalt met de Growth Lead welke campagnes eraan komen en welke content daarvoor nodig is. Je maakt het contentplan op en stippelt de aanpak uit met ondersteuning van de Teamlead.
* Je zet de richting uit voor SEO en GEO. Daarin experimenteer je met content: welke onderwerpen, formaten en hooks testen we? Wat werkt, wat niet? Onze Content Marketeer voert uit, jij denkt mee en coacht.

**Wat we zoeken in jou**

* Je hebt vier tot acht jaar ervaring met B2B-contentmarketing, grotendeels in een uitvoerende rol en liefst in een scale-up. Da’s een richtlijn, geen harde vereiste.
* Je hebt ruime ervaring met het vertalen van een contentstrategie naar een plan, inclusief de rapportage die toont wat het opleverde.
* Je bouwde al eerder een AI-contentworkflow waar een team vlot mee aan de slag kon. Je weet tot waar AI een hulpmiddel is en waar de expertise van ons team het stuur overneemt.
* Je Nederlands is perfect. Franstalige content kan je beoordelen op tekst én inhoud, en in het Engels kan je ook communiceren.
* SEO en GEO ken je van binnenuit: wat een pagina laat ranken en wat een AI-assistent laat citeren. Een experiment zonder hypotheses, meetcriteria en rapportage? Da’s voor jou geen experiment, maar fietsen met je ogen dicht (en we weten allemaal dat dat eindigt bij een onverwachts paaltje).

**Waarom werken bij o2o Bicycle Leasing?**
Bij o2o moedigen we je aan om het beste uit jezelf te halen. Je persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling, net als je welzijn, zijn een absolute prioriteit.
  
  
We geloven dat flexibiliteit je productiviteit alleen maar ten goede komt. Daarom krijg je de kans om dagen op kantoor af te wisselen met thuiswerk en sporen we je aan om genoeg te deconnecteren.
  
  
**Wat onze medewerkers vooral appreciëren?**

* Een job met betekenis.
* Flexibiliteit in werkplek en werkuren.
* Een team waar je bij wil horen (en blijven).
* Vertrouwen als basis, niet als beloning.
* Onbeperkt betaald verlof – nee, dat is geen typefout.
* Een aantrekkelijk loon en een stevig fietsleasebudget.
* Sportieve en minder sportieve activiteiten (lees: aperitiefjes) die je niet móét meemaken, maar vaak wel wíl.

**De route naar je nieuwe job**

* Solliciteer – gewoon via de knop hieronder of via jobs@o2o.be.
* Kennismaking Thibaud van HR – pas je in ons team?
* Gesprek met de enige echte Isa (teamlead marketing) en de collega’s - ben jij de Content Lead die we zoeken?
* Je werkt een case uit en presenteert die live bij ons op kantoor. Je krijgt altijd feedback, ook als het niets wordt.
* Iedereen enthousiast? Dan volgt je aanbod en start jouw o2o-avontuur.

Klaar om mee te trappen?
  
  
Voel je het al kriebelen? Laat van je horen. We zijn benieuwd naar wie je bent en wat je brengt – ongeacht je achtergrond, leeftijd, gender of favoriete fietstype.

* You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in digital communications, intranets, content strategy, information architecture and/or user experience.
* You have a hands-on experience improving an intranet or website structure, preferably in a complex or international organisation.

* A good knowledge of UX and accessibility principles is a nice to have.
* A good level of Dutch and/or French and English is required.

**About The Role**
As Application Marketeer for Food Manufacturers Benelux, you will inspire B2B customers across Bakery & Pastry, Confectionery, Ice Cream and Retail by translating market, consumer and customer insights into application-led growth opportunities. You will develop compelling concepts and customer propositions that help customers enhance their end products with Barry Callebaut ingredients and chocolate solutions. This newly created individual contributor role combines strategic thinking with hands-on commercial activation, customer co-creation and innovation, while working closely with Sales, R&D, Product Management and application teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Drive application-led growth initiatives across key market segments and product categories.
* Translate consumer trends, market intelligence and data sources, including Nielsen and Euromonitor, into customer concepts and growth opportunities.
* Develop engaging application stories, commercial presentations and activation materials for customer meetings and pitches.
* Partner with Account Managers to present concepts and propositions that support commercial growth plans.
* Lead customer inspiration sessions, innovation workshops and co-creation activities within our academies.
* Coordinate with chefs, application labs, R&D, Product Management and Sales teams to bring concepts to life and prepare relevant samples and solutions.
* Identify portfolio gaps, innovation opportunities and emerging market trends to strengthen customer value propositions.
* Monitor the impact of marketing initiatives and customer engagement activities in collaboration with Sales.
* Align local initiatives with regional and global marketing strategies while managing multiple stakeholders effectively.

**About You**

* Master’s degree or equivalent through experience.
* Approximately 5 years of experience in marketing, category management, innovation or a related commercial role.
* Experience within the Food & Beverage industry in an international environment is required.
* Strong understanding of consumer, customer, retail and market dynamics.
* Proven ability to translate insights and trends into commercially relevant concepts and go-to-market actions.
* Analytical mindset combined with creativity and a passion for food.
* Proactive, hands-on and entrepreneurial approach with a strong sense of ownership.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to inspire customers through presentations and workshops.
* Comfortable working independently and bringing structure to complex situations.
* Fluency in Dutch and English is required; French is an advantage.

At Barry Callebaut, we are on a journey to transform the cocoa and chocolate industry. As the world’s leading manufacturer of high-quality chocolate and cocoa products, our actions truly shape the future of our industry. We are a business-to-business company, serving the entire food sector, from the cocoa bean to the finest chocolate product. We are a company with a purpose, we believe in doing well by doing good and reinvesting in the communities we operate. We have a long-standing commitment to sustainability and our goal is to shape a sustainable cocoa and chocolate future. We are headquartered in Zurich, and have more than 12,000 passionate Employees working in more than 40 countries worldwide. We are very proud of who we are and what we do. And of course, we are always looking for talented people to help us have a positive impact on our industry and beyond!
  
  
At Barry Callebaut, we are committed to Diversity & Inclusion. United by our strong values, we thrive on the diversity of who we are, where we come from, what we’ve experienced and how we think. We are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment where people can truly be themselves, grow to their full potential and feel they belong.
**#oneBC - Diverse People, Sustainable Growth.**

**About Us 👇**
Lemlist is the bootstrapped, profitable group behind lemlist, Taplio, Tweet Hunter and Claap. We build tools that help people sell and grow, with a small team that ships fast and owns its results.
  
  
🔵
**Taplio**
is the all-in-one tool to grow on LinkedIn: write, schedule, engage and analyze, now with AI agents.
  
  
And Taplio is changing fast:
  
  

* Taplio is an official Claude connector. People can run their LinkedIn from Claude in one click.
* We just launched Ask Taplio, our LinkedIn agent.

The product moves faster than the world knows. That's where you come in.
  
  
Your mission
  
  
Make Taplio's product marketing take off through content we own, the creators who talk about us and the partners who sell for us.
  
  
You are creative, you love content, and you want every launch to land with the people who live on LinkedIn: founders, consultants, creators and their teams.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
**Own our content channels**
→ Newsletters: run our product newsletter and our creator newsletters (LinkedIn Weekly, Content Corner): editorial line, writing, segmentation, results.
  
  
→ Short form video: turn real product use cases ("Taplio in Claude", Ask Taplio) into shorts and reels for LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.
  
  
→ YouTube: build tutorials on the searches people make before they buy ("how to connect Taplio to Claude", "Claude for LinkedIn").
  
  
→ Webinars: one live session a month, solo or with a partner, then recycle it into clips, posts and pages.
  
  
**Launch What We Ship**
→ Positioning, messaging and launch plan for each release (the Claude connector, Ask Taplio, the next ones).
  
  
→ Launch assets: announcement, demo video, newsletter, creator brief, affiliate kit.
  
  
→ A use case library: one real task a week, with its prompt and its result.
  
  
**Run creator partnerships**
→ Find the creators whose audience converts, negotiate, brief, track (one tagged link per creator, no exceptions).
  
  
→ Decide with data who we rebook and who we stop.
  
  
**Grow the affiliate and partner community**
→ Animate our affiliate program: contests, kits, comparison content and tutorials they can publish.
  
  
→ Turn our best affiliates, LinkedIn trainers and agencies into real partners (training, support package, public partner page).
  
  
→ Keep the program clean: fraud checks and inactive cleanup.
  
  
**Measure everything**
→ Every channel has a number: trials, paying customers, cost per customer. You report weekly on impact, not activity, and you kill what doesn't work.

* You know Taplio and our MCP inside out, and you've shipped your first launch end to end.
* The product newsletter and the webinar run on a monthly rhythm, each with tracked results.

* Our partnership program is launched, and first business results are seen.

**Within 6 months**

* Short form video and YouTube tutorials bring a measurable share of new business.
* Creator spend has a target cost per customer, and you hit it regularly.
* Our partnership program is a growing and reliable source of new business.

Who you are
  
  

* 2+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, in content, product marketing, creator or community roles.

* Good negotiator. You can say no to a creator's price and keep a good relationship.

**What's Not Required**

* A big-brand background. We prefer someone who has built things with a small budget.
* Being an on-camera star. Comfort on camera helps, but a good script and a good edit matter more.
* Being a developer. You need to understand what an MCP does, not to code one.
* Having run an affiliate program before. We'll show you the tools.

What's in it for you?
  
  

* A product people love and a launch almost every month.
* Real ownership: your channels, your budget, your numbers.
* 38 days of holidays + 3 extra days.
* Premium health insurance, meal tickets, transport pass, top of the line equipment.
* A yearly team retreat with the whole crew.

Recruitment process
  
  

* 30-min screening call with Victoire Lead TA
* Interview with Virgile Growth Lead @ taplio
* Async business case + 45-min live debrief
* Interview with Patrice GM @ taplio
* Final interview with Oriane COO
* Reference check, then offer

send your LinkedIn profile and one piece of content you made and are proud of (a video, a newsletter, a webinar, a post).

job.title: Content Creator @ Koninklijke Nederlandse Zwembond (KNZB) (Nieuwegein, Utrecht, Netherlands)
job.description:
***Maak de zwemsport zichtbaar. Vertel de verhalen die mensen bijblijven.***

De Koninklijke Nederlandse Zwembond (KNZB) is de drijvende kracht achter de zwemsport in Nederland. Onze missie is het bevorderen van zwemmen in al zijn vormen, van breedtesport tot topsport, en het creëren van een veilig en plezierig zwemklimaat voor iedereen. Met een rijke geschiedenis en een breed scala aan activiteiten is de KNZB een toonaangevende organisatie in de Nederlandse sportwereld.

Om de zwemsport nog zichtbaarder te maken en meer mensen te enthousiasmeren om te kijken, mee te doen en betrokken te raken, versterken we ons communicatieteam. Daarom zoeken wij een creatieve Content Creator die de verhalen en bijzondere momenten uit de zwemsport tot leven brengt.

**De functie**

Hoe zorg je ervoor dat mensen niet alleen naar een wedstrijd kijken, maar ook het verhaal achter de sporter willen kennen? Dat een bijzondere prestatie, een spannend toernooi of een persoonlijk verhaal uit de zwemsport mensen raakt en nieuwsgierig maakt?

Als Content Creator ben jij de maker die deze verhalen tot leven brengt. Je bedenkt en maakt aansprekende content, met name voor social media. Van wedstrijdzwemmen en waterpolo tot synchroonzwemmen, schoonspringen, openwaterzwemmen en waterbasketbal: jij weet de energie en bijzondere momenten van deze sporten te vertalen naar content die mensen willen bekijken en delen.

Je bent regelmatig aanwezig bij wedstrijden en evenementen, denkt mee over nieuwe ideeën en formats en werkt nauw samen met collega's binnen marketing, communicatie, commercie en events. Jouw belangrijkste kracht ligt in het daadwerkelijk maken en publiceren van content.

Content maken en publiceren

-     Je maakt content die past bij het kanaal, de doelgroep en het moment.

-     Je bedenkt, filmt, monteert en publiceert korte video's voor onze social kanalen.

-     Je ontwikkelt creatieve formats en series die de zwemsport herkenbaar en aantrekkelijk in beeld brengen.

De verhalen achter de sport vertellen

-     Je brengt sporters, coaches, talenten, vrijwilligers en verenigingen in beeld.

-     Je weet bijzondere momenten, emoties en prestaties te vertalen naar aansprekende verhalen.

-     Je bent aanwezig bij wedstrijden, toernooien en andere sportevenementen en zorgt, waar relevant, voor snelle publicatie van content.

-     Je werkt, indien nodig, samen met fotografen, videografen en andere makers om de juiste beelden beschikbaar te krijgen.

Samenwerken en verbeteren

-     Je werkt samen met collega’s aan de uitvoering van de contentplanning en de doorontwikkeling van formats.

-     Je ondersteunt collega’s bij de totstandkoming van campagnes met passend beeld en video.

-     Je verwerkt commerciële partners op een natuurlijke manier in content, in afstemming met de commerciële collega’s.

-     Je volgt de prestaties van je content, signaleert wat werkt en komt met ideeën om bereik en betrokkenheid te vergroten.

Je bent een creatieve maker met gevoel voor beeld, tekst, timing en verhalen. Je weet hoe je met een video of tekst direct de aandacht trekt en begrijpt dat goede sportcontent meer is dan alleen een wedstrijdregistratie.

-     Ervaring met filmen en monteren, bijvoorbeeld met een smartphone en camera;

-     Ervaring met CapCut, Premiere Pro, Figma of vergelijkbare tools;

-     Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal en voldoende Engels om met internationale sporters en betrokkenen te werken;

-     Een proactieve, creatieve en zelfstandige werkhouding;

-     Bereidheid om op locatie content te maken en snel te schakelen;

-     Affiniteit met zwemmen, waterpolo of een van de andere zwemsporten is een pré.

Een portfolio met eigen werk is belangrijker dan een lange lijst diploma's. We willen vooral zien wat je kunt maken en welk effect jouw content heeft gehad.

**Waarom kiezen voor de KNZB?**

Bij de KNZB krijg je de kans om midden in de Nederlandse (top)sport te werken. Je bent dicht bij sporters, coaches en verenigingen en maakt bijzondere wedstrijden en evenementen in binnen- en buitenland van dichtbij mee.

Je krijgt ruimte om eigen ideeën en creatieve formats te ontwikkelen en werkt samen met betrokken collega's uit marketing, communicatie, commercie en events. Samen zetten jullie je in om de zwemsport zichtbaarder te maken en meer mensen te enthousiasmeren.

Je werkt in een organisatie vol ambitie, energie en beweging, waar samenwerking centraal staat en ruimte is voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

**Wat bieden wij?**

-     Een creatieve functie dicht op de Nederlandse (top)sport(ers);

-     Ruimte om eigen ideeën en formats te ontwikkelen;

-     De mogelijkheid om wedstrijden en evenementen in binnen- en buitenland van dichtbij mee te maken;

-     Samenwerking met collega's uit marketing, communicatie, commercie en events met als doel om de zichtbaarheid van de zwemsport te vergroten.

-     Een salaris conform cao Sport (schaal 7/8);

-     8% vakantiegeld, een eindejaarsuitkering volgens cao Sport en een goede pensioenregeling (PFZW);

-     Een fulltime dienstverband (1,0 fte);

-     Laptop en overige middelen die voor de functie benodigd zijn;

-     Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid tot hybride werken, passend bij de werkzaamheden;

-     Opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden;

-     Collectieve ziektekostenverzekeringen.

**Wat verder belangrijk is:**
deze functie vraagt om flexibiliteit. Wedstrijden en toernooien vinden regelmatig plaats in de avonduren en weekenden. Ook reizen binnen Nederland en incidenteel naar internationale evenementen hoort erbij.

Stuur je cv, een motivatie en een link naar je portfolio, showreel of drie contentvoorbeelden waar je trots op bent

naar sollicitaties@knzb.nl. Vertel daarbij wat jouw bijdrage was en, waar mogelijk, welke resultaten je hebt bereikt.

De eerste gespreksronde staat gepland op maandagmiddag 14 december in Nieuwegein.

FI Analytics is a young and ambitious company focused on digital marketing and data analysis. We're looking for a SEO/GEO Content Marketer to join our team of digital marketing experts. Our client wants to become the biggest credit card in Germany. Today, people find financial products in two ways: they search, and they ask AI. Both reward the brands that are the clearest, most trustworthy, and most useful answer. We need someone to build that position.

**In a world where hearing protection is essential for health and well-being, Alpine Hearing Protection plays a crucial role making healthy hearing accessible to everyone. With a presence in over 65 countries, Alpine is dedicated to protecting hearing worldwide—because sound is precious.**

*’'Taking care of your ears should be as simple as brushing your teeth. Our goal is to set new standards for hearing protection, ensuring a better sound experience for everyone.’’*
  
**– Arthur van Keeken, Chief Executive Officer**

**About Alpine as a company**
-----------------------------

Alpine Hearing Protection is a leading global brand specializing in high-quality hearing protection solutions. Alpine was founded in 1994 by Bert van Beek, his daughter Lisette, and Peter de Roode. With Bert’s experience in hearing protection and the marketing background of Peter and Lisette, they set out on a mission to raise awareness about hearing damage. With a strong commitment to innovation, comfort, and safety, Alpine develops premium products that cater to a wide range of industries and consumer needs. From musicians and motorcyclists to festival-goers, children, and professionals exposed to high noise levels, Alpine provides tailored solutions to protect hearing without compromising sound experience.
  
Alpine’s extensive product portfolio includes award-winning hearing protectors such as the Alpine PartyPlug, MotoSafe, SleepDeep, and MusicSafe, each designed to offer maximum comfort and effective noise reduction. The brand has built a strong reputation for quality and reliability, earning recognition and certifications from leading safety organizations.
  
With a dedicated team of specialists, Alpine continuously pushes the boundaries of technology, focusing on research-driven product development and customer-centric design. Their mission is to make healthy hearing accessible to everyone, and they won’t rest until hearing protection becomes second nature. By making next-level hearing protection available for every situation and every type of ear, Alpine is building a new generation of healthy hearing.

Operating in over 65 countries, Alpine has a strong international presence, with products available through online marketplaces (such as Amazon and Bol.com), specialty retailers, and major distributors. The company is focused on global expansion, aiming to strengthen its position as a leader in hearing protection while continuing to grow in new markets. Alpine is also enhancing its direct-to-consumer experience through its own webshop, backed by an innovative lab dedicated to product development. The company fosters a dynamic and collaborative culture that drives continuous improvement. With key leaders like Maurice Barten (formerly of Jumbo) and Arthur van Keeken (from Nestlé), Alpine is powered by top-tier talent committed to achieving long-term growth and success.

**About the role: CRM Specialist**
----------------------------------

Your primary responsibility will be to develop and execute a CRM strategy that transforms buyers into loyal customers. While some initial loyalty efforts have been made within CRM, it’s now time to establish a strategic foundation that supports Alpine’s continued growth. Your key responsibilities include:

* Building our CRM strategy from the ground up, leveraging customer insights and identifying new business opportunities in the hearing protection market.
* Drive sustainable growth of our customer database through targeted acquisition campaigns and retention strategies.
* Creating and implementing an integrated communication approach across email, web, social, and other channels that resonates with our diverse customer base. You’ll introduce advanced segmentation to enable true personalization.
* Designing and launching customer journey communications that reflect key moments in the hearing protection journey and the customer lifecycle.
* Working together with copywriters and designers to ensure they produce compelling content that fits the email flows and communication strategies you've developed.
  

**What are we looking for in you as a CRM Specialist?**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Proven CRM experience: You have multiple years of experience with CRM in an e-commerce environment and are able to both formulate and implement a strategy. Your main focus has been on loyalty and commercial campaigns.
* Results-driven mindset: You are a results-oriented professional with a data-driven approach to decision-making. You have the skills to identify key opportunities and implement strategies that improve webshop performance and drive revenue growth.
* Collaborative & resilient: You’re energetic and an excellent communicator, as you’ll be working closely with others in a project-based environment. You know how to bring people along with your ideas, but also how to deal with setbacks and change. Alpine is growing rapidly, and change is a constant — your entrepreneurial mindset helps you navigate this dynamic environment with confidence and adaptability.
  

**What does Alpine offer you as a CRM Specialist?**
---------------------------------------------------

* A salary dependent on knowledge and experience, up to € 65.000,- a year.
* Good opportunities for personal development and training budget.
* Be part of a fantastic, ambitious team with many annual outings, such as a sailing trip, company overnight, Christmas party and more.
* Free tickets for the many great races and festivals where Alpine is present.
* Free lunch twice a week at the office.
* Weekly free company workout

**Over Hiiper**

Hiiper heeft de ambitie om hét leidende data & insights bedrijf van Europa te worden op het gebied van consumenten­ aankoopinzichten, over alle branches heen. We zijn een ondernemende en snelgroeiende scale-up met jarenlange ervaring op het raakvlak van data, technologie en commerciële activatie binnen (food)retail en daarbuiten.

Als onderdeel van de Woolsocks Group (waaronder Woolsocks, Scoupy en de OK-app) verzamelen we dagelijks – volledig privacy-proof – enorme hoeveelheden aankoopdata via banktransacties en kassabonnen. Daarmee begrijpen we als geen ander wat consumenten kopen, waar en wanneer, zowel online als offline, in Nederland en komend jaar in verschillende andere Europese landen. Met slimme modellen, dashboards en inzichten helpen we retailers en merken om datagedreven te groeien.

**Wat ga je doen als Insights Consultant?**

Je combineert klantadvies met zelf analyseren en het uitbouwen van samenwerkingen. Je werkt nauw samen met data-analisten, data scientists en commerciële collega’s. Jij gaat aan de slag met:

* Klanten begeleiden: je bent hun vaste aanspreekpunt, doorgrondt hun doelen en helpt dashboards en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties;
* Analyses en adviezen maken: je vertaalt businessvragen naar een analyseaanpak en presenteert heldere conclusies en aanbevelingen;
* Samenwerkingen uitbouwen: je signaleert klantbehoeften en ondersteunt klantgesprekken, demonstraties en voorstellen met overtuigende inzichten;

We geloven in de kracht van AI-modellen als ondersteuning van ons werk. Daarom zoeken we zelfstandige denkers die deze tools optimaal benutten, de output kritisch toetsen en zelf de regie en verantwoordelijkheid houden over analyses, conclusies en adviezen.

**Wat breng jij mee?**

Je bent klantgericht, analytisch en commercieel ingesteld. Je neemt eigenaarschap, werkt gestructureerd en schakelt soepel tussen data en klantgesprekken. Daarnaast heb je:

* een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding met een analytische component, bij voorkeur universitair, zoals econometrie, economie of business analytics;
* 3–6 jaar relevante ervaring als consultant, business analyst of insights professional;
* ervaring met zelfstandig analyseren, klantcontact en stakeholdermanagement, en het vertalen van businessvragen naar begrijpelijke rapportages en adviezen;
* sterke Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met analytics- of dashboardingtools;

Affiniteit met aankoopgedrag, FMCG en retail is een pré; nieuwsgierigheid naar data en analyses is een must.
